content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: finally home, couch mode activated
Me: same, just walked in like two mins ago
Maya: ugh my feet hurt, too much pacing on calls
Me: lol wfh pacing counts as cardio?
Maya: exactly, I'm counting it
Maya: did your maybe-mug survive glaze night?
Me: barely lol, it's very shiny now and still lopsided
Maya: shiny lopsided is an upgrade tho
Me: that's what the teacher said, now it holds pens
Maya: love that, from keys to pens empire
Me: how's your stomach today? still calm?
Maya: yeah actually good, oat milk in cereal was weirdly fine
Me: oh you tried it? full review?
Maya: creamy, a little sweet, 7/10 would eat again
Me: solid score
Maya: what are you doing for dinner? soup again?
Me: probably, it's chilly with the window open again
Maya: same, I closed mine halfway already
Me: oh hey so annoying thing about Friday
Me: my work meeting got extended, it runs til 12:15 now
Me: can we slide like half an hour later than noon?
Maya: ugh of course, Friday meetings love to expand
Maya: yeah 12:30 works for me, I'll just walk over a little later
Me: thank youuu, I can still slip out right after, just need like 15 to get over there
Maya: perfect, no rush at all, I'll aim for 12:30 too
Me: you're the best, still good for like an hour-ish?
Maya: yeah plenty, my 2pm call is still there so that actually helps
Me: oh nice, less rushed then
Maya: exactly, how's miracle basil's cousin doing? your plants?
Me: less droopy, I moved one to the windowsill like you said
Maya: yesss windowsill magic, told you",
  "writer_note": "Kept the lunch reference minimal without restating the restaurant, and buried the noon to 12:30 shift due to the 12:15 meeting inside normal couch/plant/pottery chatter to match their voice and afternoon timing."
}
